camps.name: Casa de la Rumba
camps.description: The most magical prohibition era Casino where you can come and try our whimsical cocktails while trying your luck at our roulette or Blackjack table all under our glorious circus tent. Come get some rumba to our Casa. Celebrate sharing, life, and try your luck in our little casino. You can come and bet whatever you have on you and we will match it up. Be prepared to walk in a different time and sp…

camps.name: Chariot Project
camps.description: Injured? Have a footsie-oopsie-daisy? Fear not! Chariot Project has a rainbow fleet for hurt feet. Our pedal-powered mobility carts are available for checkout by the day to attach to your own bike. While you are here you can explore our collection of canes, orthopedic boots, knee braces, and more to help you on your healing journey.

camps.name: Camp Bird of Paradise
camps.description: Camp Bird of Paradise will have a prominent banner across the front of our permanent large community shade structure which reads "Camp Bird of Paradise"

camps.name: The Airship
camps.description: The Airship is a steampunk inspired bar camp that's returning to the Playa for our second year. Our little crew of miscreants, scoundrels, and artists want to gift some fun and frivolity to the Playa in the form of themed bar night and a lounge for relaxing!

camps.name: Khaleeya
camps.description: Come immerse yourself in a world of Moroccan bliss at Khaleeya (formerly TeaHive)—where the hive thrives in harmony.

camps.name: ANTIIX
camps.description: Ludus (playful love) Symposium (Meeting for music, drinking and intellectual discussion) is a place to hang out on our friendly deck/bar above the playa and watch cheezy cult movies.

camps.name: Duane's Whirld
camps.description: DuanesWhirld is enjoying our 19th consecutive year en Playa, with many of our campers trekking from Vermont. Our camp supports the mutant vehicle Fluffy -- accessible public transit masquerading as a cloud wafting across the playa. A wheelchair lift and Braille rails accommodate that many more Burners into the artcar experience. We enjoy mass-gifting our fellow Burners with Deep Playa Beer Deliver…

camps.name: Sepia Lux Homebase
camps.description: Come find the Cuttlefish (and Flash the Tortoise) back at their lair and say hi!

camps.name: Camp Balagan
camps.description: Balagan Camp exists to create a playful, soulful, and immersive Moroccan desert experience rooted in music, connection, and creativity. "Balagan" is a joyful chaos — we embrace that spirit with curated sonic journeys, shared rituals, and a warm, open atmosphere for self-expression and cultural fusion.

camps.name: Cult of the Magic Lady
camps.description: Come to our Cult, we have snacks! The snacks are babies, but don't worry, they are alcoholic. We also have a church, for your physical wellbeing and personal gains. And we feed on your shame. We also have a library.

camps.name: Children of Chaos
camps.description: Children of Chaos, established in 2000, is returning to the playa! Join our Gold Parade, have your fortune told, stop by our conversation bar and have a drink and a chat! Our campers hail from Reno, Portland, Seattle, San Francisco, Denver, and Houston.

camps.name: Camp Zoombox
camps.description: A giant boombox and some rad people

camps.name: Dancing Cat
camps.description: Dancing Cat Wine Bar! Where there's alittle something for everyone!

camps.name: SYMBIO
camps.description: Symbio is a Burning Man camp built on the essence of symbiosis—a close-knit family of Playa-loving souls who support and uplift one another. Rooted in connection, collaboration, and radical self-expression, we create a welcoming home for our community while fueling the journey of our beloved mutant vehicle, Dirty Owl. More than just a camp, Symbio is a dynamic fusion of energy, creativity, and sup…

camps.name: Nomad Collective
camps.description: Nomad Collective Camp is a sanctuary for those who live and thrive through music. Born from a passion for electronic sound and deep connection, our camp creates an immersive space where beats and community blend seamlessly. We welcome both seasoned Burners and first-time dreamers, fostering creativity, self-expression, and unforgettable sonic journeys. As our family grows, so does our commitment t…

camps.name: OHM HOME
camps.description: We are a mutant vehicle support camp. Home of Ohm Kar, Manta and Vibe Apple. Come n boogie. Take the ride.

camps.name: Atomic Octopus
camps.description: A neighborhood dive bar that welcomes dreamers, schemers, and big thinkers. Come share ideas with like-minded individuals. Schedules and activities will be posted out front. Time travelers welcome.

camps.name: Wild Child
camps.description: Run away to our circus community, hosted by world class artists, where every day is filled with workshops designed to ignite your passion for performance. Dive into the world of partner acrobatics, master the art of flow props, explore the freedom of parkour, and unleash your creativity with tricking sessions. Whether you're a seasoned performer or curious beginner our inclusive community welcomes…

camps.name: Lands Beyond
camps.description: Lands Beyond is a haven for strivers and adventurers always seeking the unknown. We help you break through barriers and reach outside your comfort zone to attain your higher self. A globally-minded camp with Mexican flair, come join us for tasty micheladas and all-day aguas frescas inside our cosmic neon-lit dome. Ecstatic dance, breathwork, dynamic meditation, and cacao ceremonies are also on the…

camps.name: Grilled Cheese Experiment
camps.description: Serving gooey grilled cheese realness, the One Sin Spa, and Literal Table Flipping to fine creatures of Black Rock City!

camps.name: Wild Free Spirit
camps.description: The Wild Free Spirit Camp is an immersive art experience set inside a large motorhome with seating and immersive lighting. The general welcoming area will be lit with lighting and seating. The immersive art experience and general welcoming areas are open to all ages

camps.name: High Desert Cinema
camps.description: Movie Night! 8:00pm Hot Buttered popcorn & theater candy! Come hang out!

camps.name: Johnny Tacomas at The Last Resort
Don't STOP
camps.description: Black Rock City is a place where small things can derail your day or night and we want to support our fellow burners by offering small necessities [ex. tampons, condoms, sunscreen, or glowy things] from our Don't Stop Gift Box, or a drink with inspired conversation. Additionally, we offer opportunities to restore through Yoga and breathwork and learn how to repair your bike.

camps.name: Jipangu/Bijou Boutique
camps.description: Come visit us for Japanese sake (21+) and drop-in jewelry making workshops. There is also a Boutique to select or share a special piece of jewelry.

camps.name: Making Art at the Mad Tea Party

members.bio: Shade rigger and off-grid power nerd. If it needs guying down in 40mph wind, I'm your Burner.
members.avail: Can host 2 in the Bay Area
